quarterly_data.signal: 1Q26 earnings-conference deck: Q1 sales NT$43.4 billion, up 19% YoY, with Cloud & AIoT delivering ~50% yearly growth; cloud-related business achieved over 70% revenue growth on increased shipments of cloud computing products for AI server power management and energy storage. Excluding a one-off inventory write-down allowance (1.05% of Q1 sales), gross margin was 22.8% and operating margin 10.5%. Q1 net profit reached NT$3.78 billion and EPS NT$1.66, up 10% YoY, a five-year high for the same period.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 net profit NT$3.78 billion; EPS NT$1.66 (+10% YoY); gross margin 22.8% and operating margin 10.5% excluding the write-down (1.05% of Q1 sales); Cloud & AIoT ~50% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Deck: the board resolved a U.S. investment of US$919 million for long-term investments in land, buildings, plant and equipment to expand energy products and production capacity supporting AI infrastructure. The company frames its strategic capex expansion as transforming from a power supplier to an AI system integration partner, with early deployment of AI energy infrastructure and system-integration capacity and an expanding North American and global footprint.
quarterly_data.figure: US$919 million U.S. investment (land, buildings, plant and equipment)

quarterly_data.signal: Deck (2Q26 outlook): core businesses expected to deliver strong yearly and quarterly growth; key modules for the 50V Integrated Power Rack (8.5kW PSU & BBU, Sidecard, DC PDU) entering mass production, 110kW Power Shelf shipments, robust demand for the 33kW Power Shelf, the 800VDC Power Rack undergoing certification and 2.5kW DCDC Power Bricks entering mass production in 2H. The deck's 2026 (1H / 2H) roadmap lists the 33kW Power Shelf, 5.5kW PSU, 800VDC 660kW Power Rack, 110kW Power Shelf, 18.3kW PSU, 8.5kW PSU & BBU, 800VDC >1.5MW Power Rack, an in-rack power rack and a 2.5kW DCDC brick (50 VDC input, 12 VDC output).
quarterly_data.figure: 2.5kW DCDC bricks mass production in 2H 2026; 800VDC 660kW and >1.5MW power racks; 18.3kW PSU
